summary: Correction-only amendment over the RESEARCH-OS-MIGRATION-design claim, superseding 2026-07-11T084642Z_research-os-migration_RESEARCH-OS-MIGRATION-design (approved via 2026-07-11T084858Z_user-approval_RESEARCH-OS-MIGRATION-design.json), following a read-only audit of the pushed migrate/research-os-layer branch (target HEAD 5820d2d95f64bc59cdaf1f83d1381720443cda2d) which found implementation defects and one unauthorized scope change against the then-accepted contract. This correction strengthens automation/acceptance/research-os-migration.yaml only -- it does not migrate, copy, move, delete, merge, commit, push, or regenerate anything in research-os, and does not touch migrate/research-os-layer or main. Six corrections applied: (1) absolute_path_classification_policy (new section): replaces the prior unconditional 'zero matches outside the gitignored local override' wording, which the audited implementation's superseding migration claim self-authorizedly reinterpreted as a 'scoped pass' after finding literal C:\Users\Hesar\... paths inside this very contract's own prose (independently confirmed present at lines ~317/366 by the audit). The corrected policy defines two explicit categories -- active_machine_path_matches (must equal exactly 0, a hard unconditional gate covering active tracked registries, runtime configuration, generated status/dashboard, new claims/approvals, migration_provenance.yaml runtime fields, executable code defaults, and committed local overrides) and historical_documentary_literal_matches (every occurrence individually enumerated by file/line/excerpt/justification, never used as runtime configuration or copied into new content, always human-reviewed) -- and explicitly forbids a bare 'pass' or 'scoped pass' string as sufficient acceptance evidence going forward. (2) gitattributes_policy (new section): makes the exact, non-discretionary decision that a .gitattributes file MAY be added for migrated code/documentation paths but MUST include an explicit 'automation/receipts/** -text' exclusion line so historical receipts are never subject to Git's line-ending normalization; requires any future implementation to restore already-normalized receipts to their exact source-snapshot bytes and prove this via raw sha256 comparison (never JSON-content-equivalence), directly correcting the audit's finding that 29 of 68 shared historical receipts changed from CRLF to LF due to an undocumented, overly broad .gitattributes rule the first implementation attempt introduced without it being named in the accepted inventory. (3) actively_reverified_durable_and_rerunnable (replacing actively_reverified_expected_identical_counts): requires TOOL-REXP, DASH-D3, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID, REG-CANDIDATES, NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, DASH-NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, and (newly added per this correction) EXTERNAL-REPO-RESOLUTION to be verified via a durable, re-runnable, task-specific check from research-os -- e.g. actually invoking the resolver or re-running EXTERNAL-REPO-RESOLUTION's own test assertions -- never the generic 'historical-receipt-hash' shortcut the audit found applied uniformly to every predating task via update_dashboard.py's is_historical_source_receipt() short-circuit, which made a future resolver/evidence regression invisible to a re-run of --verify; requires a visibly distinct strength/state label (e.g. actively-reverified-cross-repository) rather than the same generic label used for tasks with no live cross-repository dependency; explicitly permits the target check schema/count to differ from the source's original count provided every target check is explicit, task-specific, and durable, never a single generic placeholder standing in for what were many distinct assertions. (4) AUT-TSG-impl's special-case entry gains a required_exact_annotation field mandating the dashboard render, reachably regardless of internal verification code path, the exact statement 'Historical acceptance only -- operational enforcement remains in wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo and is not active from research-os.' -- directly correcting the audit's finding that the implementation's NON_MIGRATED_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE annotation mechanism existed in code but was unreachable/dead for this specific task because the earlier historical-receipt shortcut short-circuited before that code path was ever reached. (5) implementation_validation_suite gained an explicit byte-level status-idempotency criterion requiring RESEARCH_DASHBOARD.md AND automation/status.json to be independently raw-sha256-identical across two consecutive renders with no source-fingerprint change -- stronger than '--check reports PASS' alone, since the audit's own (accidental, reverted) render test found status.json's raw bytes differing across two renders despite --check passing, implying --check's internal comparison may tolerate a volatile field a raw diff would catch; also strengthened the byte-identity and absolute-path implementation_validation_suite line items to reference the new sections instead of the old bare wording. (6) new correction_consequences section: states explicitly that the existing target-repository implementation claims (2026-07-11T093919Z superseded by 2026-07-11T094307Z, approved by 2026-07-11T094324Z_user-approval_RESEARCH-OS-MIGRATION.json, at target commits de0f1aa6056ee8cba3eb25e9adac5f52a76f01ad/5820d2d95f64bc59cdaf1f83d1381720443cda2d) remain historical records of what was done under the prior, uncorrected contract text -- never edited, deleted, or reinterpreted -- but are explicitly INSUFFICIENT to satisfy this corrected contract; any future migration-implementation work must capture a new SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_SHA (with this correction's own future commit recorded later as a floor, never hard-coded here), rebuild or update migrate/research-os-layer (or a successor branch), and create a new superseding RESEARCH-OS-MIGRATION implementation claim and approval once this corrected design is itself accepted. YAML re-parsed successfully via yaml.safe_load (30 top-level keys, up from 27 -- three new sections: gitattributes_policy, absolute_path_classification_policy, correction_consequences). Independently re-verified via re-hash that both prior receipts on this task (2026-07-11T084642Z claim, 2026-07-11T084858Z approval) remain byte-unchanged: 20c64a4aeda47e1a6298fcd6ce5fae38fb6ed84330b1e8593fed841b9ce26a9a and 6a635328c9ce57063d13ba3235c38ff4c70126c79138efb6bd0975bf8052cc19 respectively -- neither hand-edited. Confirmed via direct inspection that C:\Users\Hesar\Documents\GitHub\research-os remains completely untouched: migrate/research-os-layer still at 5820d2d95f64bc59cdaf1f83d1381720443cda2d, main still at b997ed6aba4e3395c3b02eef951b3536450b8961, clean tracked working tree, both re-verified before and after this correction. No migration, copy, deletion, merge, experiment, pilot, queue action, protocol change, or held-out-test read occurred. automation/registry/, automation/reviews/, automation/experiment_queue.yaml, automation/frontier.yaml, automation/literature/, all protocol-freeze records, all test-split-guard files, and scripts/automation/ remain byte-unchanged in the source repository, confirmed via git diff --stat showing zero output against the full protected-file list.
